Rashi on Keritot 9b:13:1.hebrew: והאמרת אינו מביא אלא קרבן אחד - על נגעים הרבה, אלמא חד צרעת אריכתא היא, ואמאי מחייבת ליה לאתויי צפרים אכל נגע:
Rashi on Keritot 9b:13:1.english: But didn't you say he brings only one offering - for many afflictions [of leprosy]; thus, it is one continuous leprosy, so why do you obligate him to bring birds for each affliction?

Rashi on Keritot 9b:13:2.hebrew: ולאקבועיה בעניות כו' - וה"ק: ולא עלו הצפרין ליקבע בעניות ובעשירות, דאם היה עני בשעת הבאת צפרין והעשיר, צריך להביא קרבן עשיר; ואם היה עשיר והעני, מביא עני בדלות, עד שיביא חטאתו, דבתר חטאת אזלינן בין בעניות בין בעשירות:
Rashi on Keritot 9b:13:2.english: And to establish [him] in poverty, etc. - And this is what [the Mishnah] is saying: The birds do not count to establish [his status] with respect to poverty or affluence; for if he was poor at the time of bringing the birds and [subsequently] became rich, he must bring a rich man's offering; and if he was rich and became poor, he brings [the offering of] a poor man in poverty — until he brings his sin offering, for we follow [his status at the time of] the sin offering, whether in poverty or in affluence.

Rashi on Keritot 9b:15:1.hebrew: אשר לא תשיג ידו - בשעת טהרתו יביא בעניות, אע"פ שהעשיר:
Rashi on Keritot 9b:15:1.english: Whose means do not suffice - At the time of his purification, he brings [his offering] in poverty, even though he [subsequently] became rich.

Rashi on Keritot 9b:15:2.hebrew: ר"ש סבר - האי טהרתו היינו דבר המכפר חטאו, דעל ז' דברים נגעים באין במסכת ערכין (דף טז.):
Rashi on Keritot 9b:15:2.english: Rabbi Shimon holds - This [term] "his purification" means the matter that atones for his sin, for leprosy comes on account of seven things, [as taught] in tractate Arakhin (16a).

Rashi on Keritot 9b:15:3.hebrew: דבר המכשירו - אשם שמדמו נותנין על בהונותיו, מכשירו בקדשים:
Rashi on Keritot 9b:15:3.english: The matter that renders him fit - [This is] the guilt offering, of whose blood they place [some] on his thumbs [and big toes], [thereby] rendering him fit [to partake] of sacred foods.

Rashi on Keritot 9b:15:4.hebrew: צפרין - גורמין לו תחלת טהרתו, שמדם הצפור מזין עליו:
Rashi on Keritot 9b:15:4.english: Birds - [They] cause the beginning of his purification for him, for they sprinkle from the blood of the bird upon him.

Rashi on Keritot 9b:16:1.hebrew: האשה שילדה ולדות - וקא מפרש כיצד, כגון שהפילה לתוך פ' של נקבה וכו', כגון שטבלה לאחר שבועיים דטומאה, ושמשה ונתעברה, והפילה נקבה לאחר מ' של יצירת הולד, דהיינו נ"ד ללידה ראשונה, וחזרה והפילה לסוף נ"ד של זו. ולהכי נקט נקבה, דבזכרים ליכא למימר הכי, דאי הפילה בתוך מ' דזכר, מיא בעלמא הוא האי שני, דאין הולד נוצר עד יום מ':
Rashi on Keritot 9b:16:1.english: A woman who gave birth to offspring - And [the Mishnah] explains how: for example, where she miscarried within eighty [days] of [the birth of] a female, etc. — for instance, where she immersed after the two weeks of impurity, and had relations and conceived, and miscarried a female after forty [days] of the formation of the fetus, which is fifty-four [days] from the first birth, and she again miscarried at the end of fifty-four [days] of this [one]. And for this reason [the Mishnah] specifies a female, because with males one cannot say this, for if she miscarried within forty [days] of a male, this second [fetus] is mere fluid, since the fetus is not formed until day forty.

Rashi on Keritot 9b:17:1.hebrew: והמפלת תאומים - אפילו זכרים, כגון שנתעברה ג', והפילה אחד לאחר מ', והשני נשתהה ויצא בתוך ימי טוהר הראשון, ושלישי בתוך ימי טוהר דשני, מביאה קרבן אחד על האחרון ופטורה:
Rashi on Keritot 9b:17:1.english: And [a woman] who miscarries twins - Even males: for example, where she conceived three, and miscarried one after forty [days], and the second lingered and emerged within the days of purification of the first, and [the] third within the days of purification of the second — she brings one offering for the last [one] and is exempt.

Rashi on Keritot 9b:18:1.hebrew: ר' יהודה - פליג בין אולדות בין אתאומין, ואמר: מביאה קרבן אחד על הראשון — על הולד הראשון — ולא על השני, מפני שנולד בתוך מלאת של ראשון. ומביאה על השלישי, משום דהוא לא נולד תוך מלאת, דלא חשבינן מלאת לשני, דכמאן דליתיה דמי הואיל ונולד תוך מלאת של ראשון, ושלישי הוי תחילת לידה. ואינה מביאה קרבן על הרביעי, הואיל ונולד תוך (מ') מלאת של שלישי. אבל שלישי לא נולד תוך מלאת דראשון, דהא עברו ימי טומאה דראשון (ויצירת שני וטומאתו ויצירת שלישי), דהוי טפי מפ' לראשון. וגבי תאומים נמי דקפליג ר' יהודה, כגון שנולד שלישי לאחר מלאת דראשון, ועל מלאת דשני לא איכפת לו, דכמאן דליתיה דמי:
Rashi on Keritot 9b:18:1.english: Rabbi Yehuda - [He] disagrees both regarding [multiple] births and regarding twins, and says: She brings one offering for the first — [meaning] for the first offspring — and not for the second, because it was born within [the days of] completion of the first. And she brings [an offering] for the third, because it was not born within [the days of] completion, for we do not reckon [days of] completion for the second — as it is considered as if it does not exist, since it was born within [the days of] completion of the first — and [thus] the third is [considered] the beginning of a [new] birth. And she does not bring an offering for the fourth, since it was born within [the days of] completion of the third. However, the third was not born within [the days of] completion of the first, for the days of impurity of the first (and the formation of the second, and its impurity, and the formation of the third) have already passed, which is more than eighty [days] from the first. And regarding twins as well, where Rabbi Yehuda disagrees, [it is] a case where the third was born after [the days of] completion of the first, and he is not concerned about [the days of] completion of the second, for it is considered as if it does not exist.

Rashi on Keritot 9b:19:1.english: Gemara - Wherever "torat" ["law of"] is written, it implies many [births].

Rashi on Keritot 9b:19:2.hebrew: יכול על הלידה ועל הזיבה - קרבן אחד. כגון שראתה ג' ימים בימי זיבה, והפסיקה רביעי, וילדה בחמישי, הרי זו יולדת בזוב, כדאמרי' בנדה (דף לו:) דבעי שתפסוק מן הזוב סמוך ללידה, ואם לא פסקה — ודאי דם מחמת הולד, ואינה יולדת בזוב:
Rashi on Keritot 9b:19:2.english: [One] might [have thought] for the birth and for the ziva - [that she brings] one offering. For example, where she saw [blood for] three days during the days of ziva, and ceased [bleeding on the] fourth [day], and gave birth on the fifth [day], behold, this [woman] is a woman who gives birth in [a state of] zov [yoledet be-zov], as we say in Niddah (36b) that she must cease from the zov close to the birth; and if she did not cease, [it is] certainly blood [caused] by the fetus, and she is not a woman who gives birth in [a state of] zov.

Rashi on Keritot 9b:20:1.hebrew: אלא מעתה - מהיכא תיסק דעתיה דעל הלידה ועל הזיבה קרבן אחד, דאיצטריך קרא למעוטי? הא ודאי, אכלה חלב וילדה, מי סלקא אדעתין דמביאה קרבן אחד על הלידה ועל החלב? וגבי זיבה נמי, מה ענינה אצל לידה:
Rashi on Keritot 9b:20:1.english: If that is so - From where would it enter his mind that for childbirth and for ziva [she brings] one offering, such that a verse is needed to exclude [it]? Surely, [if] she ate forbidden fat and gave birth, would it enter our mind that she brings one offering for the childbirth and for the forbidden fat? And regarding ziva as well, what does it have to do with childbirth?

Rashi on Keritot 9b:21:1.hebrew: זאת - משמע על לידה אחת מביאה [קרבן אחד על ולדות הרבה], הא אחר מלאת חייב על כל אחת ואחת:
Rashi on Keritot 9b:21:1.english: This - implies [that] for one birth she brings [one offering for many children]; however, [for a birth] after the completion [of the term], [she] is obligated [to bring an offering] for each and every one.

Rashi on Keritot 9b:22:1.hebrew: לדברי ר' יהודה - מדלא חשיב מלאת לשני, ש"מ ולד ראשון גורם לקרבן, ומולד ראשון מונה פ' יום. הילכך, שלישי שנולד אחר מלאת דראשון, ולד מעליא הוא לקרבן:
Rashi on Keritot 9b:22:1.english: According to Rabbi Yehuda - Since he does not count [days of] completion [of purification] for the second [fetus], learn from this [that the] first fetus causes [the obligation for] the offering, and from the first fetus she counts eighty days. Therefore, the third [fetus], which was born after the completion [period] of the first, is a valid fetus [to obligate her] for an offering.

Rashi on Keritot 9b:22:2.hebrew: לדברי חכמים - דלא מחייבי אלא חד, אבתרא מחייבי ליה, דסבירא להו ולד שני — כלומר, אחרון — גורם לקרבן, וראשון, דלא מלו ימי טוהר דיליה, לית ליה קרבן; ומשני מנינן מלאת עד שלישי, ומשלישי עד רביעי, ולא מטמא מלאת אלא עד בתרא:
Rashi on Keritot 9b:22:2.english: According to the Sages - Who only obligate [her in] one [offering], they obligate her for the last one, for they hold [that] the second fetus — that is to say, the latter [one] — causes [the obligation of] the offering, and the first [one], whose days of purity were not completed, has no offering; and from the second [one] we count [the] completion [period] until the third [one], and from the third until the fourth, and [the] completion [period] does not arrive until [after] the last one.

Rashi on Keritot 9b:23:1.hebrew: פשיטא דהכי איתא - דאי לאו הכי, מאי טעמייהו:
Rashi on Keritot 9b:23:1.english: It is obvious that it is so - For if [it were] not so, what [would be] their reason?

Rashi on Keritot 9b:23:2.hebrew: מפלת תאומים איצטריכא ליה - משום מפלת תאומים איצטריך ליה תנא לאשמועינן דבמפלת תאומים נמי פליג רבי יהודה, דמהו דתימא בתאומים מודה דחדא לידה אריכתא היא, הואיל ועיבורן כאחת, ואית ליה נמי מלאת לשני, ושלישי לאו בר קרבן הוא:
Rashi on Keritot 9b:23:2.english: [A woman who] miscarries twins was necessary for him - Because of [a woman who] miscarries twins, it was necessary for the tanna to teach us that in [the case of a woman who] miscarries twins, Rabbi Yehuda also disagrees; for what might you have said? [That] with twins he concedes that it is one extended birth, since their conception was together, and the second [fetus] also has [its own period of] completion [of purification days], and [thus] the third [fetus] is not subject to an offering.

Rashi on Keritot 9b:3:1.hebrew: נזירות טהרה משביעי חיילא - הלכך, כי נטמא תרי זימני בשביעי, הוו להו טומאות הרבה, דהא אתחלא נזירות דטהרה. ולענין קרבן, לא מחייב אלא אחד, דלא יצא אדם זה לשעה ראויה לקרבן:
Rashi on Keritot 9b:3:1.english: Naziriteship of purity takes effect from the seventh [day] - Therefore, when he became impure two times on the seventh [day], they are [considered] multiple impurities, since the naziriteship of purity had [already] begun. And regarding an offering, he is liable [for] only one, since this person did not reach a time fit for an offering.

Rashi on Keritot 9b:6:1.english: And he shall sanctify his head - [This means] that [the] naziriteship of purity takes effect upon him. The day of his shaving, etc.

Rashi on Keritot 9b:8:1.english: One who issues a warning to his wife, etc. - He brings one barley meal offering for all of them when he makes [her] drink.

Rashi on Keritot 9b:8:2.hebrew: שנתנגע נגעים הרבה - כגון שספר שבעה ולא הספיק להביא קרבנותיו עד שנתנגע, וכן שניה, וכן שלישית:
Rashi on Keritot 9b:8:2.english: Who was afflicted [with] several afflictions - For example, he counted seven [days] and did not manage to bring his offerings before he was afflicted [again], and similarly a second [time], and similarly a third [time].

Rashi on Keritot 9b:9:1.hebrew: הביא צפרין - אותן שתי צפרין חיות, אחת לשחיטה ואחת לשילוח, ולאו קרבן נינהו:
Rashi on Keritot 9b:9:1.english: He brought birds - Those two live birds, one for slaughtering and one for sending away, and they are not a sacrifice.

Rashi on Keritot 9b:9:2.hebrew: לא עלו לו - קס"ד דהאי לא עלו לו משמע שצריך לחזור ולהביא לבסוף שתי צפרין לכל נגע ונגע עד שיביא חטאת; אבל הביא צפרין וחטאתו ונתנגע, אין צריך להביא לכשיטהר על נגע ראשון:
Rashi on Keritot 9b:9:2.english: They do not count for him - We initially assumed that this [expression] "they do not count for him" means that he must go back and bring at the end two birds for each and every affliction, [if it occurred] before he brings a sin offering; however, [if] he brought [the] birds and his sin offering and [then] became afflicted, he does not need to bring [birds again] when he becomes pure for the first affliction.

Tosafot on Keritot 9b:11:1.hebrew: תורה אחת למצורעים הרבה - ובתורת כהנים מפיק ליה מדכתיב "וכבשה אחת", מלמד שמביא אחת על נגעים הרבה; ומוזאת תהיה תורת דריש: תורה אחת לכל מצורעין, לפי שמצינו שחלק הכתוב בטומאותיהם ובשבועותיהם:
Tosafot on Keritot 9b:11:1.english: "One law for several lepers" - And in Torat Kohanim, it derives it from that which is written, "and one ewe lamb" [Leviticus 14:10], [which] teaches that he brings one [offering] for many leprosy afflictions; and from "This shall be the law of [the leper]" [Leviticus 14:2], it expounds: one law for all lepers, because we find that Scripture differentiated regarding their impurities and their seven-day periods.

Tosafot on Keritot 9b:1:1.hebrew: והיא שפחה לחלק על כל שפחה ושפחה - תימה, דהכא בעינא לחלק אע"ג דגופין מוחלקין, והתם פרק אותו ואת בנו (חולין פב:) — "לא תשחטו ביום אחד" — משמע דפשיטא דחייב גבי שחטה ואח"כ שחט בניה, משום דגופין מוחלקין, אע"ג דליכא קרא; וכן לקמן בפרק אמרו לו (כריתות דף יז.), דאמרי: שבתות כי גופין דמיין:
Tosafot on Keritot 9b:1:1.english: "And she is a maidservant" — to separate [liability] for each and every maidservant - This is astonishing, for here we require [a verse] to separate [liability] even though they are separate bodies, whereas there, in Chapter Oto ve'et Beno (Chullin 82b), [regarding] "you shall not slaughter [it and its young] on one day," it implies that it is obvious that one is liable where he slaughtered her [the mother] and afterwards slaughtered her offspring, because they are separate bodies, even though there is no verse [teaching separation]. And similarly below, in Chapter Ameru Lo (Keritot 17a), where they say that [distinct] Sabbaths are considered like separate bodies.

Tosafot on Keritot 9b:23:1.hebrew: מפלת תאומים איצטריכא ליה - סד"א במפלת תאומים מודה רבי יהודה לרבנן. וקשה, דא"כ מפלת תאומי' למאן קתני לה? אי רבנן — פשיטא, ואי לר' יהודה — הא מודה לרבנן! צ"ע:
Tosafot on Keritot 9b:23:1.english: [The case of] a woman who miscarries twins was necessary for him [to teach] - It might have entered your mind to say that in [the case of] a woman who miscarries twins, Rabbi Yehuda concedes to the Rabbis. And this is difficult: for if so, according to whom does [the Mishnah] teach [the case of] a woman who miscarries twins? If [it is according to] the Rabbis — it is obvious! And if [it is according to] Rabbi Yehuda — behold, he concedes to the Rabbis! [This] requires further study.
